items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: It was -- they all patterned after Fletcher Henderson, Ellington, Don Redman, and the different bands like that.

ctx.x: No, he came -- he was leader when he came. And they -- at first they used to play a whole bunch of Ellington type arrangements. They used to copy off of records, plus the other numbers that they did, and that was a new trend too, this record copying business, because the eastern bands were definitely more advanced than the western bands in those days.
I don't think there was even a western style, hardly, in those early days. It was -- they all patterned after Fletcher Henderson, Ellington, Don Redman, and the different bands like that.
Did Lionel Hampton join the band with Les Hite?
